sarah_chen.name: Sarah Chen
sarah_chen.title: Futurologist & AI Ethicist
sarah_chen.bio_long: Sarah Chen is a leading voice in technology ethics and future forecasting. Her work focuses on creating responsible AI development models, ensuring that technological advancement is aligned with human values and social equity. She advises global tech firms and policymakers on the moral implications of large language models, quantum computing, and decentralized governance. She also speaks passionately about human potential in an AI-driven world.

elias_vidal.name: Dr. Elias Vidal
elias_vidal.title: Organizational Psychologist
elias_vidal.bio_long: Dr. Elias Vidal specializes in transforming corporate cultures through psychological principles. His research explores the dynamics of team resilience, burnout prevention, and optimal leadership structures in high-stress environments. He provides keynote speeches on fostering psychological safety, driving innovation through diverse teams, and building robust mental frameworks for modern leaders. His clients include Fortune 500 companies and elite sports organizations.

jaya_patel.name: Jaya Patel
jaya_patel.title: Sustainable Design Advocate
jaya_patel.bio_long: Jaya Patel is a celebrated advocate for sustainable development, focusing on how design thinking can revolutionize material usage and production cycles. Her work champions the concept of the circular economy, moving away from waste generation to regenerative systems. She speaks globally on green manufacturing processes, urban infrastructure planning, and the essential role of corporate social responsibility in the face of climate change.
